Status: Implemented and focused tests passed.

Implementation: `_on_error` now formats the capitalized process name, exact command, error type, and Qt error detail. FailedToStart adds the executable hint on non-Windows when the detail ends with either missing-file or permission-denied text (including Qt's `execvp:` prefix).

TDD: Added regression tests first; the focused run failed on the original generic message. After implementation, `xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x1024x24' env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -q -p no:xvfb --reruns 0 tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py` exited 0 with 29 passed.

Tests failing during setup included `tests/end2end/features/test_open_bdd.py::test_open_s[http://]`, `tests/end2end/misc/test_runners_e2e.py::test_command_expansion[foo{{url}}bar-foo{url}bar]`, and multiple tests under `tests/end2end/test_adblock_e2e.py`, `tests/end2end/test_dirbrowser.py`, and `tests/end2end/test_hints_html.py`.

Additional verification: `xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x1024x24' env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -q -p no:xvfb --reruns 0 tests/unit/misc` exited 1 without a pytest failure summary after output reached `tests/unit/misc/test_elf.py .....`; the exact cause is unknown from its output. The focused GUIProcess suite still exited 0 with all 29 tests passing. `git diff --check` exited 0.

Remaining: None for the requested fix; full-suite confidence is limited by the environment's QtWebKit failure and the unexplained unit/misc run exit.

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('detail', ['No such file or directory',
+                                    'Permission denied'])
+def test_start_error_has_executable_hint(fake_proc, message_mock, monkeypatch,
+                                         caplog, detail):
+    """A missing or inaccessible command gets an actionable error."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', False)
+    fake_proc.start('missing-command', [])
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = detail
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(QProcess.FailedToStart)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == (
+        "Testprocess 'missing-command' failed to start: {} "
+        "(Hint: Make sure 'missing-command' exists and is executable)"
+    ).format(detail)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('error, detail, expected', [
+    (QProcess.FailedToStart, 'Executable format error',
+     "Testprocess 'my-command' failed to start: Executable format error"),
+    (QProcess.Crashed, 'Process crashed',
+     "Testprocess 'my-command' crashed: Process crashed"),
+    (QProcess.Timedout, 'Timed out',
+     "Testprocess 'my-command' timed out: Timed out"),
+    (QProcess.WriteError, 'Broken pipe',
+     "Testprocess 'my-command' write error: Broken pipe"),
+    (QProcess.ReadError, 'Input/output error',
+     "Testprocess 'my-command' read error: Input/output error"),
+])
+def test_process_error_identifies_command_and_type(fake_proc, message_mock,
+                                                   monkeypatch, caplog, error,
+                                                   detail, expected):
+    """Each process error reports its type and the exact command."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', True)
+    fake_proc.start('my-command', [])
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = detail
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(error)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == expected
+
+
+def test_start_error_on_windows_has_no_executable_hint(fake_proc, message_mock,
+                                                       monkeypatch, caplog):
+    """The executable hint only appears on non-Windows platforms."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', True)
+    fake_proc.start('missing-command', [])
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = 'No such file or directory'
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(QProcess.FailedToStart)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == ("Testprocess 'missing-command' failed to start: "
+                        "No such file or directory")
